Question 2
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with velocity v(t)=cos⁡(4t), where t is the time. If the particle is at the position x=3 when t=0, calculate the position x of the particle at time t>0.

a
x(t)=3+14sin⁡(4t)
b
 x(t)=3+sin⁡(4t)
c
x(t)=3−14sin⁡(4t)
d
x(t)=14sin⁡(4t)
e
x(t)=14sin⁡(4t+3)
Submit
